title: Weekly Rental Charges and Trip Rebates on Wayfare Rentals
content:
A Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) vehicle is charged by the week, and each week can earn back part of its charge through a trip rebate.

## The weekly charge

A weekly charge of the class's weekly rate is booked on the first day of each rental week while the vehicle is out. A rental week runs from the pickup weekday to the same weekday a week later, and the rental continues week to week until the vehicle is returned. Nothing is refunded for a week cut short: when the vehicle comes back mid-week, that week's charge stands in full. The shortest rental is 1 week, and there is no fee for returning before the end of a rental week ($0.00). Each charge is booked once per rental week, identified by the first day of that week.

## The trip rebate

At the end of each rental week a rebate is credited against that week's rental, set by the trips completed that week. The highest step of the class's trip rebate ladder reached applies, and steps never add up. The rebate is recorded for the week it belongs to, and a week that reaches no step has no rebate.

**Which trips count.** A trip counts toward a rental week when all of the following hold:

- the renter drove it as the driver;
- it was driven under the driver services agreement the rental is linked to;
- it is completed;
- its drop-off falls inside the rental week, which starts at the first day of the week (included) and ends at the same weekday a week later (not included).

## What the weekly rate already covers

The rental includes maintenance, insurance and roadside assistance as listed for the product, and these are never charged separately.

## A hypothetical rental week, worked through

A Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan is collected on a Tuesday. Its weekly rate is $269.00 and its rebate steps are $25.00 at 30 completed trips, $55.00 at 50 and $90.00 at 70.

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Weekly charge, booked on the opening Tuesday | $269.00 |
| Trips by the renter under the linked agreement, completed, drop-off from that Tuesday up to but not including the next Tuesday | 53 |
| Highest step reached | 50 trips |
| Rebate credited at the end of the week | $55.00 (the 30-trip amount is not added) |
| Weekly charge less rebate | $214.00 |

Within that count, a completed trip with drop-off on the closing Monday shortly before midnight counts for this week; a trip with drop-off just after midnight on the next Tuesday counts for the following week; a cancelled trip, or a trip driven under a different driver services agreement, does not count.

## Points of judgement

- If the same vehicle is returned on the Friday of that week, the $269.00 charge stands and no part of it is refunded; no further weekly charge is booked once the vehicle is no longer out.
- With 49 counting trips the week reaches the 30-trip step and earns $25.00; with 50 it earns $55.00.
